name: Bologna
intro: Explore 582 records from Bologna’s official ACER building layer: 576 source-verified buildings and six unresolved source features. Every marker is positioned inside its source footprint.
mapLabel: Interactive map of ACER public-housing buildings in Bologna
footnote: 576 source-verified buildings; six additional features under review. Repeated source features were consolidated using building codes and overlapping footprints. This is not a complete census or an occupancy check.
